title: Ancestor's Last Wish
next_chapter_hook: Just as the ancestor's figure was about to dissipate, a page of yellowed fragment emerged from his withered palm—this was the legendary Fourth Page of the Tianji Record, containing secrets not even Mo Xiansheng knew...

text.content: The ancestor's wraith slowly materialized in the pitch-black void. That aged face overlapped with the blurry ancestral shrine portrait in Chen Ji's memory, yet carried an additional layer of vicissitude and sorrow. His voice resonated like an ancient bell struck after millennia, heavy and distant: "I have waited for this moment far too long." Mo Xiansheng's form trembled beside Chen Ji, as if wanting to speak, yet an invisible force held him bound.

dialogue.content: "Who exactly are you? Why does Mo Xiansheng fear so much my probing into your identity?" Chen Ji's voice was calm to the point of cold indifference, but his clenched fists betrayed the turmoil within. The ancestor's wraith merely offered a bitter smile—a smile containing too many things he could not decipher.

text.content: "Who am I? I am the first Sword-Bearer of the Chen Family, ten thousand years ago, and also the first person chosen by the Tianji Record." The ancestor's voice carried an indescribable desolation. "As for the Mo Xiansheng you speak of, he prevented you from asking because he knows—once you learn the complete truth, there will be no path back." Before his words could finish, a golden rift suddenly tore open in the void, and countless images surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a flood.

It was a world of primordial chaos, where sun, moon, and stars had yet to be distinguished. Countless humans struggled to survive in the wilderness. An existence beyond the mortal realm descended upon the world, calling itself the Eye of Heavenly Way. It intended to select representatives from all living beings, granting some the ability to glimpse Heavenly Secrets. The Chen Family's ancestor—a ordinary huntsman's grandson—was chosen by the First Page of the Tianji Record, becoming one of the earliest seven Seers.

dialogue.content: "However, the Eye of Heavenly Way's purpose, from beginning to end, has only been one—" The ancestor's voice suddenly turned cold. "It wishes to devour the Heavenly Fate of all Seers, gathering the scattered fortune of all living beings back to itself, thereby achieving true transcendence. The seven first-generation Seers were merely... blood offerings it raised."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He下意识地 glanced at Mo Xiansheng beside him, only to find the other lowering his head tightly, his wraith-form body trembling slightly, as if enduring tremendous agony. Chen Xuan's choice back then, Mo Xiansheng had participated in the whole process—was he an accomplice, or another puppet with no choice? A complex emotion arose in Chen Ji's heart.

"Among the seven first-generation Seers, five were ultimately devoured by the Eye of Heavenly Way." The ancestor continued, his tone carrying uncontrollable grief. "My five companions vanished before my eyes, one after another. Their life force, Heavenly Fate Value, and spiritual souls were all swallowed by that invisible eye. And I... I was the only one who escaped."

dialogue.content: Escaped? Chen Ji caught that word sharply. So the Chen Family's generations of guarding the Tianji Record was not honor, but a... flight? The ancestor's wraith slowly nodded, a trace of guilt flickering in those turbid eyes: "Correct. We are not guardians; we are deserters. The Eye of Heavenly Way will not spare any who betray it, and the Tianji Record... is its only means of locating us."

text.content: Chen Ji finally understood why the Chen Family had remained so low-key through generations. Why their ancestors established the family motto of "No contending, no displaying, no revealing." Why every Chen Family descendant who inherited the Tianji Record had to walk the martial world as a废物—a perfect disguise, survival wisdom paid for with blood and tears over millennia. Yet the Eye of Heavenly Way had eventually come. Chen Xuan's death, Mo Xiansheng's predicament, and the chess game he had stepped into one step at a time...

"Chen Xuan was not the first executor." The ancestor's voice suddenly grew heavy. "Before him, seventeen generations of Chen Family descendants had taken on the Tianji Record's inheritance. Each of them had tried to resist the Eye of Heavenly Way, and each had failed—some died under the Eye of Heavenly Way's pursuit, some died from their own backlash, and others... chose self-termination in despair. Chen Xuan was the eighteenth generation, and also the one closest to the truth."

dialogue.content: Seventeen generations... Chen Ji felt his throat tighten. Those ancestors he had never met—they too had摸索 in the darkness like him,苦苦支撑 in despair. He suddenly understood why Mo Xiansheng always seemed欲言又止, understood that behind the Chen Family legends scattered in history's dust lay how many unknown tales of heroism and helplessness. This cross-millennium loneliness and burden pressed down on him, nearly suffocating him.

text.content: However, the ancestor's words did not cease: "The Eye of Heavenly Way's ultimate goal, after devouring all Seers' Heavenly Fate, is to complete one final transformation—at that time, it will no longer be the will of Heavenly Way, but will replace Heavenly Way itself. The Tianji Record Fragment in your hand is merely bait it scattered across the mortal realm. It never worried about Seers growing stronger, because the stronger a person becomes, the more miserably they die when the backlash comes."

choice.prompt: After hearing the ancestor's account, Chen Ji stood at fate's crossroads. He had to make a choice—this was the Chen Family's ten-thousand-year destiny, and also a choice he could not avoid.

choices.description: Accept the ancestor's commission, bear the Chen Family's ten-thousand-year mission, and continue the struggle against the Eye of Heavenly Way to the end. This is the most difficult path, but also the only way to break the cycle.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock [Ancestor's Blessing]: Heavenly Fate natural recovery speed increases by 50%
choices.risk_hint: What awaits on this path is endless danger and sacrifice

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly knelt: "Ancestor above, Chen Ji, the eighteenth-generation unworthy descendant of the Chen Family, is willing to inherit our predecessors' ambition and struggle against the Eye of Heavenly Way to the end." His voice was not loud, yet carried unshakeable resolve. The ancestor's wraith flickered with a trace of gratification—that was the answer he had waited ten thousand years for.

dialogue.content: For ten thousand years, seventeen ancestors have fallen on this path." Chen Ji slowly rose, his gaze burning with unprecedented light. "But they never truly failed—because their will has been passed down to this day. I will not repeat their mistakes; I will forge a brand-new path, a path even the Eye of Heavenly Way never anticipated."

choices.description: Do not blindly accept fate's arrangement; find a third path in one's own way. Rather than confronting the Eye of Heavenly Way directly, fundamentally change the rules of this game.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain [Rebel's Heart]: Resistance to the Eye of Heavenly Way's backlash increases by 30%
choices.risk_hint: This path will make him a thorn in the Eye of Heavenly Way's side

text.content: Chen Ji did not kneel immediately. He stared directly into the ancestor's eyes, his voice calm yet carrying a subtle edge: "All seventeen ancestors chose to resist, but what was the result? I refuse to repeat their mistakes. Since the Eye of Heavenly Way treats us as chess pieces, I will overturn this entire game."

dialogue.content: The ancestor's wraith fell silent. That turbid gaze flickered with complex light—surprise, gratification, even an inexplicable sense of relief. "You are the first to dare speak to me in such a manner." He murmured softly. "But perhaps... this is precisely the person the Chen Family truly needs."

choices.description: Neither inherit nor escape, but fundamentally question this so-called "fate." The Eye of Heavenly Way wants him to be Heavenly Fate fuel? Then he will reverse the situation and let it taste the flavor of backlash.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain [Cycle Breaker]: Can foresee and partially avoid backlash effects
choices.risk_hint: Breaking conventions means placing oneself in the greatest danger

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile carried a boldness he would never normally reveal: "Forgive my bluntness, Ancestor—this so-called cycle has been a joke from the very beginning. The Eye of Heavenly Way wants Heavenly Fate Value? Then give it some. It wants to devour me? Let it choke on the taste."

dialogue.content: Before his words could finish, the Tianji Record Fragment within him suddenly violently trembled. An unprecedented power surged from the fragment, creating a strange resonance with his Heavenly Fate Value. The ancestor's wraith's pupils constricted—what did he see? A faint, yet truly existing... light of hope.

text.content: The ancestor's figure began to blur even more, as if on the verge of dissipating at any moment. He gazed at this young man who had made his choice, eyes full of complex emotions. "Chen Ji, regardless of which path you choose, remember one thing—the Tianji Record is not the exclusive tool of the Eye of Heavenly Way. It is a supreme treasure left behind by ancient great cultivators, a key to breaking fate, only polluted by that eye for too long."

dialogue.content: Ancestor, please tell me—Chen Xuan, what did he... ultimately see?" Chen Ji couldn't help but ask. He wanted to know what that ancestor he had never met had discovered in the final moments of his life. The ancestor's wraith fell silent for a moment, then slowly spoke: "He saw the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record. What that page records is a secret even the Eye of Heavenly Way does not know—"

text.content: Just then, the ancestor's wraith suddenly violently convulsed. A golden thunderbolt unceremoniously struck down from the void, directly hitting his chest. "No... it has discovered me!" The ancestor's voice turned urgent and panicked. "Chen Ji, there is no time—you must remember—the Fourth Page is at—" His words were severed by the thunderbolt, his form beginning to rapidly dissipate.

Mo Xiansheng finally broke free from his constraints, shouting sternly: "Quick! Grab his hand! He can pass on one final thing before he dissipates!" Chen Ji reached out without hesitation toward the collapsing phantom. His fingers pierced through the ancestor's form, yet at the last moment touched a tangible object—a yellowed fragment, warm as if still retaining the blood temperature of ten thousand years ago.

choice.prompt: The moment the fragment entered his hand, Chen Ji felt a磅礴 surge of information flood into his Mental Sea. This was the Fourth Page of the Tianji Record—yet its contents were entirely different from what he had imagined.

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, immediately absorb the Fourth Page's contents, and turn this power to one's own use. Time is short; hesitation is not allowed.
choices.visible_reward: Tianji Record perfection increases by 10%, foresight duration extends to four hours
choices.risk_hint: The refinement process may attract the Eye of Heavenly Way's attention

text.content: Chen Ji sat cross-legged, pressing the fragment against his Brow Center. A burning force instantly surged into his Mental Sea, resonating violently with the existing Tianji Record Fragment. Intense pain struck, but he gritted his teeth without uttering a sound. Mo Xiansheng guarded nervously nearby, ready to intervene at any moment should Chen Ji falter.

choices.description: Do not rush to refine; first carefully study the Fourth Page's contents. The intelligence Chen Xuan exchanged for with his life must be ensured every character is thoroughly understood.
choices.visible_reward: Unlock [Eye of Forewarning]: Can foresee threats to oneself within the next six hours
choices.risk_hint: May miss the optimal timing for power enhancement

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the urge to refine, unfolding the fragment for careful reading. The characters upon it were ancient and obscure, yet strangely, when he calmed his mind, those characters actually manifested in his consciousness—as if an ancestor from ten thousand years ago was whispering into his ear, interpreting every word for him.

The fragment's contents made Chen Ji's pupils constrict—it was not a cultivation technique, nor a secret art, but a deliberately sealed memory. In the vision, a blurred figure stood before the Eye of Heavenly Way. That figure's outline... was unmistakably a Chen Family ancestor. He faced that existence beyond the mortal realm, his voice calm yet resolute: "You think you are manipulating fate? Laughable—every generation's sacrifice is weaving a net of death for you."

Chen Ji finally understood. The seventeen generations of Chen Family descendants' sacrifices were never meaningless struggles—each and every one of them, in their own way, had been adding a strand of silk to this web of death. And he was the one chosen to deliver this final strike. The Eye of Heavenly Way prided itself as the chess player, never knowing it was the one who had been schemed against for ten thousand years. A cold smile slowly curved Chen Ji's lips—this was the answer he wanted.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice came from behind, carrying an uncontrollable tremor: "Young master, do you understand now? Chen Xuan... he did not die from backlash; he chose to die. He used his own Heavenly Fate Value to light this final flame for you." Mo Xiansheng's eye rims reddened, his wraith-form body nearly unsteady. "This old servant has waited twenty years; finally... finally this day has come."

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He merely stood there quietly, the warm fragment in his hand, gazing toward the direction where the ancestor had dissipated. Ten thousand years of waiting, seventeen generations of blood and tears, countless ordinary yet magnificent names—all converged at this moment into a force, pouring into his bloodline. He felt something burning in his chest—that was the Chen Family's ember, an un-extinguishable flame of resistance. Mo Xiansheng knelt behind him, sobbing uncontrollably. And Chen Ji merely spoke calmly: "Tell Su Qingyao on my behalf—the plan remains unchanged—but the target... must be revised."
